title: iRacing - Johnny Guindi Skip Barber Track Guide @ Oran Park

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: at end of pit wall, lift after white line
corners.line: turn in late, keep car at angle
corners.mistakes: turning in too late, missing apex

corners.braking: brake with car a few meters after white line, keep angle straight
corners.line: turn-in after inside kerb, double apex, get close to both curbs on left

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: brake a few meters after left white curbing, drop to first gear at end
corners.line: turn in, carry brakes to apex

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: brake before the grain tires on the left side
corners.line: use all the curve on the left side
corners.exit: get on the throttle early, use all the space
corners.mistakes: overbraking, not using the space on exit

corners.braking: turn in full throttle, coast to right curbing
corners.line: turn in full throttle, coast to right curbing
corners.exit: get completely on throttle after curbing
corners.mistakes: avoid bump at end of curbing

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: brush brakes as turn, before curbing starts
corners.line: use left side of track, turn-in before curbing
corners.exit: use curve itself, avoid concrete beyond curve
corners.mistakes: going beyond curve, car bottoms out

corners.braking: Brake after curbing starts on right, drop to 3rd gear.
corners.line: Use curbing, apex near white curbing.
corners.exit: Get on throttle early, use all exit curbing.
corners.mistakes: Avoid overusing curbing, may brush brakes lightly.

corners.line: Keep car in middle of track, avoid left side
corners.mistakes: Using the white concrete on the left side
Using the white concrete on the left side, car will bottom out

corners.braking: Brake at end of brown spots, stay right.
corners.line: Turn in late, apex far in.
corners.mistakes: Inconsistent braking reference, turn in late.

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Lightly brake midway through the corner to tuck in the nose.
corners.line: Wide entry, apex at the curbing that goes from darker to lighter on the inside.
corners.exit: Get on the throttle a little bit before reaching the apex.
Get close to wall, straighten wheels fully

corners.braking: on brakes or coasting before braking
corners.mistakes: bouncing after apex if going too fast
bouncing, car unsettled if going too fast

corners.braking: Brake with a tiny bit of steering input.
corners.mistakes: Steering input can cause rear to step out.

corners.braking: lift before the white line, brake around the inside kerb
corners.line: turn-in at the white line, coast to braking point
corners.exit: coast until braking point, then brake
corners.mistakes: don't get back on the throttle until braking point

general_tips: carry brakes to apex carefully, avoid overbraking
Get on throttle early, may use grass on exit.
Use light braking midway through the corner to maintain rotation.
trail brake lightly initially, brush brakes halfway through corner
Notice the rear stepping out due to steering input rather than track bumpiness.
lift before the white line, brake around the inside kerb, coast until braking point
